translation_notes: RDF.type / OWL_NS.Class become rdf:type / owl:Class; the region is read-only so the notation only replaces term construction
the draft's 'owl-ns' prefix (mechanically derived from the OWL_NS variable name) is not usable outside islands (a hyphen stays subtraction in Python); declared as owl: instead

the OWL_NS = Namespace(...) binding is dropped, absorbed by @prefix owl:. NOTE: in the full infixowl module OWL_NS is also exported and used by other code, so a whole-file translation would have to keep the Namespace object next to the @prefix declaration (@prefix produces no runtime object)
unused-after-translation names (RDF, RDFS, Namespace) are left in the source's multi-name rdflib import, which the extract shares with the rest of the file
context shim: infixowl_ctx.py re-exports Class/Individual from rdflib.extras.infixowl (upstream of the vendored copy) so the extracted function can run; imported identically by both sides
demo harness added identically to both sides: the region is a generator, so it is exercised over a fixed Turtle document and the outcome compared as module state (demo_graph + stdout)
